children.text: Building software that solves real problems.

I’m a Software Engineer with a background in Biomedical Engineering, focused on building reliable web applications, backend systems, and cloud-based solutions. I enjoy turning complex requirements into simple, scalable products, from healthcare platforms and educational tools to APIs and automation systems.

With hands-on experience across Node.js, Express.js, Python, React, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, and cloud platforms, I work across the stack while maintaining a strong focus on backend architecture, APIs, and deployment.
I don’t just build features. I focus on understanding the problem, designing the right solution, and delivering software that works in the real world.

Contributed to the development and modernization of enterprise storage and ERP solutions, spanning frontend architecture, backend services, database benchmarking, cloud storage integration, deployment, and internal tooling. Focused on improving system reliability, performance, and release workflows across Linux-based environments.
achievements: Established a standardized database benchmarking protocol to enable consistent performance evaluation across different environments.
Led the frontend migration to a new UI architecture, resolving critical ZFS stability issues and improving overall usability and reliability.
Integrated ERP systems with cloud and local storage through MinIO/S3, enabling synchronization with Google Drive and local disks.
Deployed the initial ERP framework and optimized AI response performance to improve application responsiveness.
Architected a dedicated project-tracking and testing application to streamline test execution, bug reporting, and release management.

summary: Supported the delivery of an Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) course at Cairo University, combining technical instruction with hands-on practical sessions and academic mentorship. Worked closely with instructors to improve course materials and help students apply IoMT concepts to real-world healthcare applications.
achievements: Delivered weekly tutorials and practical sessions on IoMT architectures and medical applications to a cohort of 36 students.
Designed and evaluated quizzes, assignments, and in-class activities to assess student understanding.
Provided one-on-one academic support and project guidance, helping students translate technical concepts into practical solutions.
Collaborated with instructors to refine teaching materials and improve curriculum delivery.

description: Graduation Project: ChestVision is an AI-powered medical imaging platform developed as a graduation project, focused on generating clinical reports from full 3D chest CT scans. The system combines 3D computer vision and large language models to extract volumetric features, identify clinical findings, and generate editable medical reports through a clinician-facing web application.

title: Class Pilot
summary: Full-stack Google Classroom integration that automates assignment follow-up, reporting, and deadline-miss notifications.
problem: Teachers need a centralized way to monitor classroom activity, follow up on assignments, generate reports, and notify parents when students miss deadlines.
solution: Built a teacher-facing dashboard connected to Google Classroom that provides real-time classroom status, configurable-frequency reports, automated assignment follow-up, and WhatsApp notifications for missed deadlines.
outcome: Automated assignment follow-up and parent/teacher reporting while providing teachers with a real-time classroom dashboard and automated WhatsApp deadline-miss notifications.
seoTitle: ClassPilot — Google Classroom Assignment Follow-Up & Reporting
seoDescription: ClassPilot is a full-stack application that integrates with Google Classroom to automate assignment follow-up, classroom reporting, and WhatsApp deadline-miss notifications.

title: ChestVision — AI-Powered Medical Report Generation
summary: AI-powered medical imaging platform that processes full 3D chest CT scans and generates clinical reports using multimodal AI.
problem: Generating clinical reports from complex 3D chest CT scans requires extracting meaningful volumetric features and translating them into coherent medical language.
solution: Architected a multimodal AI pipeline combining a fine-tuned ViT3D for volumetric feature extraction with a fine-tuned LLaMA 3.2 model for clinical report generation, integrated into a full-stack application with an editable clinician-facing interface.
outcome: Achieved BLEU 0.8974, BERTScore F1 0.9920, and ViT classification F1 0.942 with AUC 0.987 for pleural effusion detection. The project received an Excellent grade.
seoDescription: ChestVision is an AI-powered medical imaging system that processes 3D chest CT scans using ViT3D and LLaMA 3.2 to generate clinical reports through a clinician-facing web application.

title: EGX Insights
summary: Full-stack Egyptian stock market tracking application that analyzes EGX companies using technical market indicators.
problem: Investors need a convenient way to monitor Egyptian market activity and compare companies using relevant technical indicators.
solution: Built a React and FastAPI application that collects market data from TradingView, with Yahoo Finance as a backup source, then summarizes EGX market activity and ranks companies based on technical indicators.
outcome: Created a full-stack market-tracking platform that aggregates EGX data and provides technical-indicator-based company analysis to support stock-purchase decisions.
seoTitle: EGX Insights — Egyptian Stock Market Analysis
seoDescription: EGX Insights is a full-stack market-tracking platform that analyzes Egyptian stocks using market data and technical indicators from TradingView and Yahoo Finance.
